headline: Saudi Civil Defence all-clear in Jazan after brief danger alert
dek: Saudi Civil Defence issued a brief danger warning for Jazan province (alert active about three minutes per Roya News) and then announced the danger had passed; two separate Najran warnings were issued and lifted earlier Wednesday morning. No cause, casualties or damage disclosed.
sources: Saudi General Directorate of Civil Defence post on X (via National Early Warning Platform)
fault_line: Are the southern alert waves precautionary signalling, or evidence of strikes Riyadh will not confirm?

sections.what_happened: Saudi Civil Defence issued a brief danger warning for Jazan province (alert active about three minutes per Roya News) and then announced the danger had passed; two separate Najran warnings were issued and lifted earlier Wednesday morning. No cause, casualties or damage disclosed. Jazan hosts a Saudi Aramco refinery of 400,000 barrels/day capacity.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source Civil Defence X posts carried by Reuters, Al Jazeera, Gulf News and Roya News
sections.what_disputed: Civil Defence disclosed no threat type, no interception claim and no damage; the alert wave (Nov 2: six warnings in five regions; Nov 3: Riyadh; Nov 4: Najran twice + Jazan) is context, not proof of any specific attack on Jazan. Ansar Allah claims of Jazan strikes on Nov 2-3 remain unconfirmed by Saudi authorities.
sections.why_matters: Another southern alert, another all-clear with no explanation — the pattern itself is the story, but an all-clear alone cannot lead a Short.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Gulf News liveblog 13:23 ; AJ liveblog 09:28 GMT = 13:28 ; Reuters via Devdiscourse): Saudi Civil Defence all-clear in Jazan after brief danger alert; Najran alerts earlier Wednesday

totw_analysis: Our read: Another southern alert, another all-clear with no explanation — the pattern itself is the story, but an all-clear alone cannot lead a Short. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Are the southern alert waves precautionary signalling, or evidence of strikes Riyadh will not confirm?
